sources.title: July 2026 Piracy and armed robbery report
sources.text: Duty crew on board an anchored ship noticed ropes and a hook on the quarter deck and two unauthorised persons in the engine room. Alarm raised resulting in the unauthorised persons escaping with stolen engine spares. The incident was reported to Jakarta VTS and local agent.
